definition.note: No (g, dh) pair is stored: the shipped row is built by the dedicated mesher we.dptail_mesh (a torus/branched-cover or multi-patch assembly); no elementary (g, dh) pair on a plane domain is stored in the code. The shipped implementation is authoritative; an unverified transcription would silently define a different surface.

provenance.definition: Derived from the Math Art generator registries and cross-referenced to the literature; not transcribed from any gallery's compilation.
sources: M. J. Callahan, D. Hoffman, W. H. Meeks III, "Embedded minimal surfaces with an infinite number of ends", Invent. Math. 96 (1989) 459-505;
M. Weber, https://minimalsurfaces.blog/ (Callahan-Hoffman-Meeks surfaces; the CHM-(1,1) notebook).

cross_checked.detail: Numerically established doubly periodic surfaces: the experimental genus-3 series (pages 78-85) and an asymmetric genus-2 surface.  'All this has only been established only numerically.'  No single genus is asserted because the shipped row carries members of different genus.
